newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gaylord cut to hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gaylord cut to hold.

text.p: -- UBS Securities analyst Edward Hatch said in a research note that he had lowered his recommendation on Gaylord Entertainment Co to hold from buy.
-- He forecast lower cash flow for the 1996-1998 period.
-- Also, he said Gaylord's third quarter results, announced late yesterday, "were below estimates due to lower-than-forecast cash flow at entertainment and cable networks."
-- Gaylord shares fell 2-7/8 to 19-1/4 in midsession NYSE trade.
